title: Claude - Issue with spend limits
text:
Service: Claude
Incident: Issue with spend limits
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2026-10-07T21:23:29.599Z
Resolved: 2026-10-07T21:23:29.656Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-07T21:23:29.656Z: resolved - We have identified an issue which resulted in some organizations to be incorrectly paused for having reached their spend limit, resulting in refused requests on the Claude API, Claude.ai, Claude Code, Claude Security, and Claude Cowork. This is now resolved.
